title: The classical Leray edge computed on a restricted resolution
statement: Let f:X→S be a scheme morphism, F an O_X-module and I an injective resolution of F. Let n be a natural number, V an open of S, U an open of X with U=f⁻¹V, and R a RestrictedResolutionSections identification of I on U [def-weil-pbc-flat-base-change-open-choices]. Restricting a class in Hⁿ(X,F) to Hⁿ(U,F|U) [def-weil-pbc-module-cohomology-fmap], applying resolutionSectionClass with R.sections and the equality U=f⁻¹V, and then the inverse comparison I.isoRightDerivedObj(f_*,n) on V gives exactly the restriction to V of its chosen classical Leray edge [lem-pc-leray-degenerate-sections]. No affine, vanishing, flatness or boundedness assumption is required.

proof.text: Apply restrictedResolution_cohomology to compute restriction before the section-class map. Naturality of the homology/evaluation comparison (NatTrans.app_homology) and sectionCohomologyTheta identifies this with restriction of the whole-open resolutionSectionClass. This calculation is proved locally as restrictedResolution_sectionClass.
Use whole_open_leray_edge to identify resolutionSectionClass at the whole open followed by the inverse derived comparison with the chosen cocycle-pinned Leray edge.

Naturality of the presheaf morphism underlying the inverse isoRightDerivedObj commutes its component with restriction from the top open to V. Combine this equation with the first two calculations and associativity. No degree, open or coefficient nonvanishing hypothesis is used.

theorem lerayEdge_restrictedResolution {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    (F : X.Modules) (I : InjectiveResolution F) (n : ℕ) (V : S.Opens)
    (U : X.Opens) (hU : U = f ⁻¹ᵁ V) (R : RestrictedResolutionSections I U) :
    moduleCohomologyRestriction U F n ≫
      resolutionSectionClass R.resolution
        (((pushforward f).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj I.cocomplex)
        V (R.sections ≪≫ eqToIso (congrArg (fun W : X.Opens ↦
          ((RingedSpace.openModuleSections X.toRingedSpace W).mapHomologicalComplex
            (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj I.cocomplex) hU)) n ≫
      Hom.app (I.isoRightDerivedObj (pushforward f) n).inv V =
    ((Classical.choose (exists_lerayEdge_isIso_of_vanishing f)) n).app F ≫
      ((((pushforward f).rightDerived n).obj F).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (show V ≤ ⊤ from le_top)).op)
